user.title: Sea State Forecast
user.description: Live waves, storms and surf for the whole planet. Choose the data sources, your home spot and the spots you want sensors for. Everything can be changed later.

data_description.sources: Global waves and weather draw the sea and the storms on the globe. Surf spots rate 112 famous breaks every 6 hours. Tropical cyclones come from GDACS.
data_description.home_spot: Gets its own sensors (rating, condition, surf height, swell period, wind, water temperature, sea state, tide). 'Nearest spot to home' picks it from your home location.
data_description.watched_spots: Each one gets a rating sensor with the full forecast as attributes.
data_description.firing_rating: Rating (0 to 5 stars) from which a spot counts as firing.
data_description.cyclone_radius_km: The 'Tropical cyclone nearby' sensor turns on when a cyclone or its forecast track comes this close to home.
data_description.grid_hours: The global grid needs about 2,300 Open-Meteo calls per update (free limit 10,000 per day). The forecast covers 48 hours, so every 12 hours is plenty.
data_description.custom_spots: One spot per line: name, latitude, longitude, swell direction (from, degrees), optional offshore wind direction (from) and optional min, ideal, max surf height in m. Example: My Reef, 7.81, 98.29, 250, 90, 0.5, 1.2, 2.5

error.no_sources: Select at least one data source.
error.bad_custom_spots: A custom spot line could not be read. Use: name, lat, lon, swell direction.

abort.already_configured: Sea State Forecast is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Sea State Forecast is already set up.

source_down.title: {source} is not reachable
source_down.description: Sea State Forecast could not load data from {source} for more than {hours} hours. The last known data is still shown. Nothing needs to be done if the source is only temporarily down; this notice disappears on its own once the source answers again.
